chip.description: Sprite generator of the 053244/053245 pair: holds the global X/Y offsets, flip and buffer-copy controls and the graphics-ROM read window.
chip.notes: Register map from src/mame/konami/k053244_k053245.cpp in MAME 0.288, whose device full name is "Konami 053244/053245 Sprite Generator". konamiic.txt lists 053245+053244 in the sprites column for Surprise Attack, Parodius, Rollergames, Lightning Fighters, Sunset Riders, TMNT 2 and others.
